content.scenario: A company, GreenTech, launches a new eco-friendly cleaning product and creates a social media campaign where a popular influencer endorses the product, stating it is 'the best for the environment'. This endorsement is posted on the influencer's Instagram and Facebook accounts, reaching millions of followers.
content.outcome: This scenario would be considered an advertisement under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as it is a public endorsement made through electronic media (social media) to promote a product.
